title: 3.5 stars for few features, but accurate and light to hold
text: 3.5 stars for few features, but accurate and light to hold. I like the hold function, but it was a little hit and miss when it will hold the temperature.  A great feature otherwise.  I like the temperature alarm setting for making jam, donuts and deep frying sensitive food.  Highly recommend you scan the instructions and keep it on your computer, as setting the temperature alarm wasn’t intuitive.  Very light to hold, and the metal spike folds safely into itself.  Does require a manual press to switch it on. Flat battery with auto shit off will preserve long life.
